source.prose:
# The soda bread I make when there is no time

## Why there is no kneading

Buttermilk and bicarbonate of soda do the work yeast would. Mix until it only just holds.

## From bowl to oven

Bake at 220C for 25 minutes, until the base sounds hollow.
